visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final portable frames against the public-domain archival exterior already published by Qualla and the explicitly public-domain NPS 2007 facade photograph. The five-bay theatre, white five-door arcade, ten shallow-arched hooded windows, pilasters, cornice/pediment, entrance steps, lower three-bay south frontage and three ridge ventilators are recognizable. Fine carvings, hardware and unseen rear service details remain medium-fi approximations.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final shared-material views, including the north-up mapped placement overlay. Metric brick, mineral trim, slate and painted-metal bindings load correctly, with portable blue-gray glazing. Whole mapped ensemble and lower rear step retain their prior alignment. No photograph is a texture. The flat fixture checks placement transforms; the separate portable/context views preserve source terrain. Unload assertion passes.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all nineteen final frames across lighting, distance, economy/high modes, front/back, silhouette and four forced detail transitions. Every frame identifies the actual current asset/runtime/detail bytes. The five-bay facade, lower south frontage, gable and three ventilators survive the distant silhouette; reduced detail remains consistent with the full exterior. Synthetic context neighbors are style fixtures, not Washington parcels.

geographicReview.notes: The west-facing 10th Street facade and lower south/Star Saloon frontage are corroborated by the public-domain Qualla 1865 exterior and NPS 2007 facade. The generalized named theatre polygon/POI remains the independent plan control. Its approximately 33.23 m combined frontage is divided into a 23.23 m theatre and approximately 10 m south wing; these are generalized dimensions, not a measured architectural survey. Anchor, heading -pi/2, +X south/+Z west, dry reference, rear step, cameras and terrain are unchanged. The preserved 4225 Terrarium samples use the 8.3888 m street datum; the -1.25 m lower closure spans the prior -0.773..0.376 m footprint relief. The north-up overlay aligns the same envelope. Ground remains coarse host data; footprint suppression stays off.

fidelityReview.scope: Surviving five-bay theatre and lower south/Star Saloon frontage, exterior only; generalized hidden rear service details.
fidelityReview.notes: Fresh comparison of all 33 current renders against the inspected public-domain Qualla 1865 exterior and the independently verified NPS 2007 facade original. The archival view confirms the roof and three ventilators; the NPS view confirms white arched doorways, entrance steps, ten hooded windows, cornice, pediment and lower south frontage. Generalized map controls supply the two-part envelope and scale. Earlier attribution-licensed photos and rights-unverified HABS illustrations are excluded from current imagery approval. Fine carving, exact roof dimensions, hardware and hidden rear openings remain estimates; no interiors or photographic textures are included.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels pass strict geometry/material/download checks and were inspected: 409/3652/8034/8034 triangles and 1/6/6/6 draws. Actual imported Float32 geometry passes 440 two-part massing/void probes and ten front-glazing checks at each level. Skyline merges materials and uses blue-gray vertex colors for the ten windows; the closer levels retain the window material. The probe checks are not a global mesh-distance measurement.

geometryValidation.notes: Raw source/skyline and all four imported Float32 meshes pass finite-attribute, nondegeneracy and winding/normal checks. All six source/runtime/detail binaries, source terrain and scene remain byte-identical to the pre-revalidation freeze; frame coordinates and cameras also remain unchanged. Exact scoped regeneration, normal import verification, strict detail/material checks, four schemas, six runtime pack members and repeated 30-tick state hashes pass. No independent Khronos certificate is claimed.
